prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D beat-em-up combat animation sprite atlas, entirely newly drawn poses based on the input reference. Output exactly ONE sheet with an invisible regular grid of EIGHT columns and SIX rows, 48 separate full-body drawings, requested canvas 2048 x 1536 pixels, equal 256 x 256 cells. True transparent RGBA background, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no effects or motion blur. Input image is character identity/costume/style reference ONLY; do not copy its six-column layout. Every cell is fully contained with safe transparent margin around every limb and complete weapon tip. Same body scale across all cells, same feet baseline within each row, whole body and whole weapon visible. Reference-quality detailed hand-painted arcade sprites with clean dark outlines and crisp shading. All characters face and attack screen RIGHT, except natural back/three-quarter views during turning strikes. It MUST be eight distinct anatomical poses per sequence, not copies translated, rocked, resized or rotated. Animate shoulder/elbow/knee/hip changes, feet pushing off, weight transfer and secondary cloth/hair follow through. Row 1 WALK: eight consecutive walking poses alternating both legs through contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, down, passing, up. Rows 2-6 are chronological attack sequences listed below. For EACH attack row eight poses: column1 relaxed ready; column2 bend knees/load hips; column3 wind weapon back; column4 drive shoulders into strike; column5 full-impact extended strike; column6 substantial follow-through; column7 recover weapon while shifting weight back; column8 settling toward ready (different from column1). Row 4 especially must show a true body pivot, visible back view in windup followed by the extended strike. Every row uses precisely eight occupied cells, no merged cells, no missing cells, no extra sprites, no duplicate poses. Subject: Nobunaga: compact muscular adult male warlord, black tied-back long hair and stern moustache/goatee face, red and gold short armor and flowing red flame-edged cape, dark trousers, red shin guards, curved katana. Exactly preserve this reference hero's recognizable identity and arcade proportions. Row order: row1 walk, row2 light1=downward diagonal katana cut, row3 light2=low-to-high rising katana cut, row4 light3=turning broad waist-height finisher slash with pelvis and shoulders visibly rotating, row5 heavy1=two-handed overhead crushing cut with deep follow-through, row6 heavy2=powerful planted-leg circular sword sweep. Preserve ALL character design invariants from reference while rebuilding the animation into eight genuine drawn poses per row.
